descriptions.w3d_d41e_heap_config_802092c8: Configures and opens a named heap: returns 1 if already open and E_FAIL without a name; reads <name>.ArenaSize, <name>.Debug (sets flag bits 3), then XOM.Arena.PassThrough or <name>.PassThrough (flag bit 16) from the config table into zero-initialised int slots, formatting each key into a 256-byte buffer, and calls the heap init with the size. Names are inferred.
